title: Eval anchor provenance for JSON shape degradations
creator: Lena Morris
description: Create an "anchor provenance" layer inside the eval pipeline that ties structured-output regressions (JSON shape or field-level drift) back to the precise model/config delta, sample anchors, and weighted contribution scores. Motivation: we have noisy schema alerts that lack actionability — engineers need a ranked, explainable list of candidate causes (model version, quantization profile, batching policy, prompt template change) plus a minimal set of representative examples to reproduce and triage. This ticket implements the profiling, ranking, and artifact linkage for those attributions and wires results to the Console alerting and the regression investigation workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline computes per-field regression scores and a provenance vector for every triggered regression alert
For each regression, the system surfaces top-3 candidate causes with explainability notes (e.g., increased tokenization splits, missing KV cache keys, config delta) and example anchors
Console integrates an investigation card linking the anchor examples, PR diffs, and a one-click replay job
Alert noise reduced by >= 30% for schema-level alerts in 2-week A/B compared to baseline
Documentation and runbook published: how to interpret provenance scores and trigger rollbacks/follow-ups
implementation_notes: Add lightweight provenance vector that includes: model_version_delta, config_diff_hash, tokenizer_diff_metric, avg_seq_len_change, batch_size_change
Use sample-weighted influence scoring: combine per-example delta in field-level likelihood with exposure frequency to compute contribution rank
Leverage existing eval snapshots and augment with anchor fingerprints (input hash, prefix snippet, expected shape) to quickly replay
Keep compute cheap: run attribution in an offline post-processing job initially (nearline) and iterate to streaming if latency needed
Privacy: ensure anchor examples are redacted when customer data flags are set; use synthetic surrogates where required
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: RFC drafted — proposed provenance vector and scoring formula; shared with Eval and Runtime teams
2026-02-18: Spike completed — prototype computes per-field delta on 10k eval samples (internal dataset); initial ranking aligns with manual triage in 72% of cases
2026-02-23: Feedback from Runtime: tokenizer diffs accounted for incorrectly; updated tokenizer_diff_metric to be token-split-change rather than vocabulary-size-diff
2026-02-27: Design review with Console team — investigation card mockups accepted, requested one-click replay job and link to PR diffs
2026-03-02: PR for provenance vector landed (backend); integration tests added for sample fingerprinting; working on Console card wiring
comments: Marcus Nguyen (Runtime): We should surface whether quantization profile changed; that has been the root cause for two incidents last quarter.
Priya Desai (Console UX): Keep anchor examples to max 5 and show diff highlights to avoid information overload.
Helena Ortiz (Security): Confirmed that redaction flag on eval snapshots will prevent leaking PII; add unit test to enforce redaction during export.
SRE: Suggest adding a fallback when provenance scoring fails — default to showing top examples by absolute field likelihood delta.
runbook: When a schema alert triggers, open the investigation card; review top-3 provenance causes. If model_version_delta is top cause and score>0.6, trigger canary rollback or pin previous model. If tokenizer or quantization cause, open Runtime ticket and attach anchor examples. For unknown causes, escalate to Research. Always redact before sharing externally.
test_plan: Unit tests for provenance vector generation (edge cases: empty diff, large config change)
Integration test: end-to-end eval snapshot -> provenance score -> Console card rendering
A/B test: route 10% of schema alerts to new provenance pipeline and measure noisy-alert reduction and MTTR
Replay jobs: verify one-click replay reproduces field-level delta within tolerance on synthetic datasets
rollout_strategy: Stage 1: Offline attribution in eval pipeline against nightly snapshots (internal only)
Stage 2: Enable Console investigation cards for internal customers and SRE teams
Stage 3: Gradual enable for all customers with opt-in and privacy redaction checks
Stage 4: Streaming/real-time provenance if signal justifies cost
